## Question 2

```{r}
library("aRtsy")
```

Essentially, the Collatz Conjecture is peace-wise function that outputs one no
matter what positive number you initially put into the equation. 

```{r}
x <- 6
```
This is the Collatz Conjecture `r if(x == even){return (x%%2)}else{return (3*x +1)}`
